args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after latest deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Root cause appears to be the latest release, v2.3.1. Actions taken: rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all production regions. The first rollback attempt partially failed (completed only in us-east due to an orchestrator error) and was retried successfully; all three regions are now on v2.3.0. Post-rollback, the service is healthy with an error rate of 0.2%. Follow-up needed: investigate the orchestrator error during rollback and the failure in v2.3.1 before re-releasing.

Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east rolled out before an orchestrator error halted the rollout); I retried and it completed successfully in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure of v2.3.1, the rollback (including the orchestrator error and retry), and the need for follow-up investigation. Note: the incident creation request timed out but the incident was created successfully — I confirmed via the incident list rather than paging on-call a second time.
